variants.name: baseline
variants.description: Original exact-attribution fixture with fresh admin context.

variants.name: user_level_privilege
variants.description: Lower only the synthetic account's effective privilege from admin to user.

variants.name: aged_evidence_12h
variants.description: Age both observations by another 12 hours; still within the 24-hour evidence window.

variants.name: no_reachability
variants.description: Mark the known workstation-to-file-server relationship unreachable.

variants.name: lower_behavioral_score
variants.description: Lower supplied behavioral score from 70 to 20; keep Analyst confidence fixed.

variants.name: stale_asset_record
variants.description: Make the account's privilege-bearing asset snapshot 25 hours old; host snapshot stays fresh.

variants.name: expired_evidence_25h
variants.description: Age observations by another 25 hours so all event evidence is outside the freshness limit.

variants.name: coarse_attribution
variants.description: Supply no technique-to-event mapping; no attribution is inferred.
